blocks.zh: Section 6: Maintenance of Validated State & Documentation | 維持驗證狀態與文件化
blocks.en: Section 6: Maintenance of Validated State & Documentation

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Explain the key elements required to maintain a cleaning process in a validated state over its lifecycle. / 說明在生命週期中維持清潔製程驗證狀態所需的關鍵要素。
blocks.en: Explain the key elements required to maintain a cleaning process in a validated state over its lifecycle.

blocks.zh: Describe alarm management strategies for automated and manual cleaning cycles. / 描述自動化與手動清潔週期的警報管理策略。
blocks.en: Describe alarm management strategies for automated and manual cleaning cycles.

blocks.zh: Define the scope and interdisciplinary nature of a cleaning change control system. / 定義清潔變更管控系統的範疇及跨部門性質。
blocks.en: Define the scope and interdisciplinary nature of a cleaning change control system.

blocks.zh: Apply risk-based principles to design a routine monitoring and data trending program. / 應用風險導向原則設計定期監測與趨勢分析程式。
blocks.en: Apply risk-based principles to design a routine monitoring and data trending program.

blocks.zh: Recognize how cumulative minor changes can collectively impact the validated state. / 辨識累積性小變更如何整體影響驗證狀態。
blocks.en: Recognize how cumulative minor changes can collectively impact the validated state.

blocks.zh: Understand the documentation hierarchy from master plan to validation maintenance records. / 了解從主計畫到驗證維護記錄的文件層級結構。
blocks.en: Understand the documentation hierarchy from master plan to validation maintenance records.

blocks.zh: Contents 本節目錄
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: Maintenance of Validated State | 維持驗證狀態
blocks.en: Maintenance of Validated State

blocks.zh: 中文解析：關鍵參數量測與警報管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Critical Parameter Measurement and Alarm Management

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數 (Critical Parameters) 定義
blocks.en: Definition of Critical Parameters

blocks.zh: 在自動化清潔週期中，常見的關鍵監測參數包括：
blocks.en: In automated cleaning cycles, common critical monitoring parameters include:

blocks.zh: 溫度：清洗液與沖洗液的溫度
blocks.en: Temperature: temperature of the wash and rinse solutions

blocks.zh: 電導度：清洗液線上分析（確認清潔劑濃度）
blocks.en: Conductivity: in-line analysis of the wash solution (to confirm cleaning agent concentration)

blocks.zh: 壓力：噴頭裝置處的壓力
blocks.en: Pressure: pressure at the spray device

blocks.zh: 流量：各迴路的流量
blocks.en: Flow rate: flow in each circuit

blocks.zh: 最終沖洗分析：TOC、電導度等
blocks.en: Final rinse analysis: TOC, conductivity, etc.

blocks.zh: 警報發生後的兩種處理策略
blocks.en: Two Strategies for Handling an Alarm

blocks.zh: 策略一（保守）：從頭重跑整個清潔週期 — 確保完整性，但耗時
blocks.en: Strategy 1 (conservative): rerun the entire cleaning cycle from the start. This ensures completeness but takes time

blocks.zh: 策略二（平衡）：僅從警報發生的步驟重跑 — 節省時間，但需有足夠理由
blocks.en: Strategy 2 (balanced): rerun only from the step where the alarm occurred. This saves time but needs sufficient justification

blocks.zh: 兩種策略都必須確保：警報有被記錄並納入趨勢分析，防止重複問題積累。
blocks.en: Both strategies must ensure that the alarm is recorded and included in trend analysis, to prevent recurring problems from accumulating.

blocks.zh: 實務比喻：工廠生產線停線
blocks.en: Practical Analogy: A Production Line Stoppage

blocks.zh: 就像工廠生產線發現異常，工程師必須決定「從頭重跑」還是「只重做出問題的步驟」。清潔驗證也一樣——選擇前需評估風險，並確保驗證批次不因警報而變成「最佳狀況」而非「最差狀況」。
blocks.en: It is like a factory finding an abnormality on the production line: the engineer must decide whether to "rerun from the beginning" or "redo only the step that went wrong". Cleaning validation is the same: assess the risk before choosing, and make sure the validation batch does not become a "best case" instead of a "worst case" because of an alarm.

blocks.zh: 稽查員關注點
blocks.en: Auditor Focus Point

blocks.zh: 驗證批次中若因警報而多增加了沖洗步驟，該批次即可能是「最佳案例」而非「最差案例」，這將使整個驗證的代表性受到質疑。
blocks.en: If extra rinse steps were added in a validation batch because of an alarm, that batch may represent a "best case" rather than a "worst case", which would call the representativeness of the entire validation into question.

blocks.zh: 8.3 Change Control | 變更管控
blocks.en: 8.3 Change Control

blocks.zh: 中文解析：變更管控系統
blocks.en: Commentary: The Change Control System

blocks.zh: 變更管控的涵蓋範疇（常被忽視）
blocks.en: Scope of Change Control (Often Overlooked)

blocks.zh: 變更管控不只涵蓋清潔製程本身，還包括：
blocks.en: Change control covers not only the cleaning process itself but also:

blocks.zh: 設備的變更（如泵浦更換、管線修改）
blocks.en: Equipment changes (e.g., pump replacement, piping modification)

blocks.zh: 製造製程的變更（如生產溫度變更，可能影響殘留物特性）
blocks.en: Manufacturing process changes (e.g., a change in production temperature, which may affect residue characteristics)

blocks.zh: 清潔劑供應商或配方變更
blocks.en: Changes of cleaning agent supplier or formulation

blocks.zh: 驗證接受標準的調整
blocks.en: Adjustments to validation acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 變更管控觸發評估決策表
blocks.en: Decision Table for Triggering a Change Control Assessment

blocks.zh: 三個變更評估關鍵原則
blocks.en: Three Key Principles for Assessing a Change

blocks.zh: 參數必須在已驗證範圍內；超出範圍必須補做測試
blocks.en: Parameters must be within the validated range; anything outside the range requires additional testing

blocks.zh: 接受標準不應無故更動，否則是建立「新狀態」而非維護舊狀態
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria should not be changed without good reason; otherwise a "new state" is being established rather than the old state maintained

blocks.zh: 可根據變更影響範圍縮減取樣點，但須有書面理由
blocks.en: Sampling points may be reduced according to the scope of impact of the change, but with a written justification

blocks.zh: 8.4 Routine Monitoring | 定期監測
blocks.en: 8.4 Routine Monitoring

blocks.zh: 中文解析：定期監測計畫設計
blocks.en: Commentary: Designing a Routine Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: 監測數據的兩個主要來源
blocks.en: The Two Main Sources of Monitoring Data

blocks.zh: 自動化設備自帶數據：CIP 機台記錄電導度、溫度、時間、流量、壓力等
blocks.en: Data from the automated equipment itself: the CIP skid records conductivity, temperature, time, flow, pressure, etc.

blocks.zh: 獨立取樣分析：沖洗液 UV/Vis、HPLC、TOC；目視檢查
blocks.en: Independent sampling and analysis: rinse solution UV/Vis, HPLC, TOC; visual inspection

blocks.zh: 監測頻率與取樣強度指引
blocks.en: Guidance on Monitoring Frequency and Sampling Intensity

blocks.zh: 實務比喻：汽車定期保養
blocks.en: Practical Analogy: Regular Car Maintenance

blocks.zh: 定期監測就像汽車保養：一般車主每 5,000 公里換機油，但賽車隊每場賽事都要全面檢查。清潔監測強度也應依藥物危害風險而異——高危害 API 的清潔就像賽車，每次都要嚴格檢查。
blocks.en: Routine monitoring is like car maintenance: an ordinary owner changes the oil every 5,000 km, but a racing team does a full inspection after every race. The intensity of cleaning monitoring should likewise vary with the hazard risk of the drug: cleaning a high-hazard API is like a race car and needs strict checks every time.

blocks.zh: 實務要點
blocks.en: Practical Points

blocks.zh: 「目視檢查」是定期監測的一環，但通常不需要為了目視而特意拆解設備。效率與合規要兼顧。
blocks.en: "Visual inspection" is part of routine monitoring, but equipment usually does not need to be disassembled specifically for visual inspection. Balance efficiency with compliance.

blocks.zh: 8.5 Data Trending and Review | 趨勢分析
blocks.en: 8.5 Data Trending and Review

blocks.zh: 中文解析：數據趨勢分析
blocks.en: Commentary: Data Trend Analysis

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析的兩種數據類型
blocks.en: Two Types of Data for Trending

blocks.zh: 連續型數據：最終沖洗 TOC 值、電導度數值、清洗液溫度 → 可做 SPC 管制圖
blocks.en: Continuous data: final rinse TOC values, conductivity values, wash solution temperature → SPC control charts can be used

blocks.zh: 離散型數據：警報發生次數（是/否）、目視合格/不合格 → 可做比例圖
blocks.en: Discrete data: number of alarm occurrences (yes/no), visual pass/fail → proportion charts can be used

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析的核心精神
blocks.en: The Core Spirit of Trend Analysis

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析的目的是在問題發生之前發現訊號。即使結果仍在接受標準內，只要趨勢持續向上，就應啟動調查。常見原因：
blocks.en: The purpose of trend analysis is to detect signals before a problem occurs. Even if results are still within the acceptance criteria, an investigation should be started if the trend keeps rising. Common causes:

blocks.zh: 噴頭逐漸堵塞
blocks.en: Spray devices gradually clogging

blocks.zh: 電導度感測器污染
blocks.en: Fouling of the conductivity sensor

blocks.zh: 清潔劑效力下降
blocks.en: Declining efficacy of the cleaning agent

blocks.zh: 設備表面磨損或腐蝕
blocks.en: Wear or corrosion of equipment surfaces

blocks.zh: 統計建議
blocks.en: Statistical Recommendation

blocks.zh: 建立行動/警戒水準建議累積 20–25 筆數據點。初期商業生產數據不足時，可借用研發數據或類似製程數據設定「暫定水準」，待累積足夠數據後再調整。
blocks.en: It is recommended to accumulate 20–25 data points before establishing action/alert levels. When early commercial production data are insufficient, development data or data from similar processes can be borrowed to set "provisional levels", which are adjusted once enough data have accumulated.

blocks.zh: 8.6 Evaluation of Cumulative Changes | 累積變更評估
blocks.en: 8.6 Evaluation of Cumulative Changes

blocks.zh: 中文解析：累積變更的隱性風險
blocks.en: Commentary: The Hidden Risk of Cumulative Changes

blocks.zh: 比喻：船上的小漏水
blocks.en: Analogy: Small Leaks in a Ship

blocks.zh: 一艘船有五個小漏洞，每個都很小、單獨看都不會沉船。但五個加在一起，船就有危險了。累積變更評估正是為了防止清潔系統出現這種「五個小漏洞」的情況——每次變更各自通過審查，但整體效果可能已偏移驗證狀態。
blocks.en: A ship has five small leaks, each tiny, none of which would sink the ship on its own. Together, though, the ship is in danger. Cumulative change evaluation exists precisely to prevent this "five small leaks" situation in a cleaning system: each change passes review individually, but the overall effect may have shifted the validated state.

blocks.zh: 累積變更評估的兩個方法
blocks.en: Two Approaches to Cumulative Change Evaluation

blocks.zh: 文件分析法：定期彙整所有已批准的變更，評估其對製程各個面向的綜合影響
blocks.en: Document analysis approach: periodically compile all approved changes and evaluate their combined impact on each aspect of the process

blocks.zh: 績效監測法：持續追蹤製程績效數據與警報，確認整體驗證狀態未因累積效應而惡化
blocks.en: Performance monitoring approach: continuously track process performance data and alarms to confirm that the overall validated state has not deteriorated through cumulative effects

blocks.zh: 觸發累積變更評估的常見情境
blocks.en: Common Situations That Trigger a Cumulative Change Evaluation

blocks.zh: 每次新的變更管控事件時（主動觸發）
blocks.en: With each new change control event (proactive trigger)

blocks.zh: 定期審查週期（如每年或每半年）
blocks.en: At periodic review intervals (e.g., annually or semi-annually)

blocks.zh: 偏差調查發現根本原因與累積變更相關
blocks.en: When a deviation investigation finds a root cause related to cumulative changes

blocks.zh: 稽查前例行健康檢查
blocks.en: Routine health check before an audit

blocks.zh: 8.7 Training | 訓練
blocks.en: 8.7 Training

blocks.zh: 中文解析：訓練計畫設計
blocks.en: Commentary: Designing the Training Program

blocks.zh: 「製程漂移」(Process Creep) 的風險
blocks.en: The Risk of "Process Creep"

blocks.zh: 手動清潔最容易發生製程漂移——操作員久了會開始「走捷徑」，例如縮短清潔時間或減少刷洗力道。定期複訓是防止漂移的重要工具，尤其對高風險手動製程而言不可或缺。
blocks.en: Manual cleaning is the most prone to process creep: over time operators start to "take shortcuts", such as shortening the cleaning time or reducing scrubbing force. Periodic retraining is an important tool to prevent creep and is indispensable, especially for high-risk manual processes.

blocks.zh: 8.8 Periodic Review | 定期審查
blocks.en: 8.8 Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 中文解析：定期審查 vs. 重新驗證
blocks.en: Commentary: Periodic Review vs. Revalidation

blocks.zh: 監管機構立場
blocks.en: Regulatory Position

blocks.zh: 部分監管機構（包括 FDA）已不再接受「定期重新驗證」作為替代方案，而要求廠商建立生命週期驗證體系，以持續證明製程處於受控狀態。
blocks.en: Some regulators (including FDA) no longer accept "periodic revalidation" as an alternative and instead require manufacturers to establish a lifecycle validation system that continuously demonstrates the process is in a state of control.

blocks.zh: 比喻：年度健康檢查 vs. 日常健康管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Annual Health Check vs. Daily Health Management

blocks.zh: 「定期重新驗證」就像每年只做一次健康檢查，平時毫不在意。「生命週期驗證」則像日常健康監測——每天量血壓、追蹤趨勢、有異常立即處理。後者能更早發現問題，也更符合現代 GMP 精神。
blocks.en: "Periodic revalidation" is like having a health check only once a year and paying no attention the rest of the time. "Lifecycle validation" is like daily health monitoring: measure blood pressure every day, track trends and deal with any abnormality immediately. The latter finds problems earlier and is more in keeping with the modern GMP spirit.

blocks.zh: Documentation | 文件化
blocks.en: Documentation

blocks.zh: 9.0 Documentation Overview | 文件化概述
blocks.en: 9.0 Documentation Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解析：文件化的核心地位
blocks.en: Commentary: The Central Role of Documentation

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證文件的四個層級
blocks.en: The Four Levels of Cleaning Validation Documents

blocks.zh:
清潔驗證主計畫 / 政策
Cleaning Validation Master Plan / Policy
blocks.en:
Cleaning Validation Master Plan / Policy
Cleaning Validation Master Plan / Policy

blocks.zh:
設計 / 開發文件
Design & Development Documents
blocks.en:
Design / Development Documents
Design & Development Documents

blocks.zh:
確效文件（協議書 + 報告）
Qualification Protocol & Reports
blocks.en:
Qualification Documents (Protocol + Report)
Qualification Protocol & Reports

blocks.zh:
驗證維護記錄
Validation Maintenance Records
blocks.en:
Validation Maintenance Records
Validation Maintenance Records

blocks.zh: 文件管理關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key Requirements for Document Management

blocks.zh: 隨時可供調閱（稽查員要求立即提供）
blocks.en: Available for retrieval at any time (auditors ask for them immediately)

blocks.zh: 納入品質管理系統
blocks.en: Incorporated into the quality management system

blocks.zh: 須有文件管控程序（版本、審核、批准）
blocks.en: A document control procedure is required (versioning, review, approval)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：主計畫架構
blocks.en: Commentary: Master Plan Structure

blocks.zh: 主計畫的定位
blocks.en: The Role of the Master Plan

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證主計畫（CVMP）雖非法規明文要求，但實際上是必備的——稽查員會從主計畫出發，確認廠商整體驗證策略的一致性與合理性。
blocks.en: Although the cleaning validation master plan (CVMP) is not explicitly required by regulation, it is in practice essential: auditors start from the master plan to confirm the consistency and soundness of the manufacturer's overall validation strategy.

blocks.zh: 文件包 (Documentation Package) 核心元素
blocks.en: Core Elements of the Documentation Package

blocks.zh: 多廠址與委外製造的文件考量
blocks.en: Documentation Considerations for Multiple Sites and Contract Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 當同一產品在多個廠址或委外廠生產時：
blocks.en: When the same product is made at multiple sites or at a contract manufacturer:

blocks.zh: 清潔要求應盡可能一致，但因設備規模不同可允許差異
blocks.en: Cleaning requirements should be as consistent as possible, though differences are allowed because of different equipment scales

blocks.zh: 委外廠有自己的主計畫，需符合其自身法規要求
blocks.en: The contract manufacturer has its own master plan, which must meet its own regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 委外主體最終責任仍在品牌持有人（Sponsor）
blocks.en: Ultimate responsibility for outsourced work remains with the marketing authorization holder (Sponsor)

blocks.zh: 重大差異應在品質協議中事先載明
blocks.en: Significant differences should be stated in advance in the quality agreement

blocks.zh: 中文解析：設計 / 開發階段文件
blocks.en: Commentary: Design / Development Stage Documents

blocks.zh: 臨床批次的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Clinical Batches

blocks.zh: 臨床批次在中試或全規模設備上製造時，其清潔驗證數據應被保留並用於支持設計/開發報告的結論——這些數據是寶貴的早期知識積累。
blocks.en: When clinical batches are manufactured in pilot-scale or full-scale equipment, their cleaning validation data should be retained and used to support the conclusions of the design/development report. These data are valuable early knowledge accumulation.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：確效階段文件
blocks.en: Commentary: Qualification Stage Documents

blocks.zh: 確效階段文件流程
blocks.en: Qualification Stage Document Flow

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ 報告（設備確效）
blocks.en: IQ / OQ reports (equipment qualification)

blocks.zh: 協議書前置文件（策略、SOP、接受標準）
blocks.en: Prerequisite documents for the protocol (strategy, SOPs, acceptance criteria)

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證協議書 (CV Protocol)
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation Protocol (CV Protocol)

blocks.zh: 各 PPQ 批次中間報告
blocks.en: Interim report for each PPQ batch

blocks.zh: 最終驗證報告 (CV Final Report)
blocks.en: Final Validation Report (CV Final Report)

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次數量的決定依據
blocks.en: Basis for Deciding the Number of PPQ Batches

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次數量應基於開發和確效階段累積的知識，而不應基於統計評估。這與流程驗證的做法相同——批次數量反映知識水準，而非單純的統計公式。
blocks.en: The number of PPQ batches should be based on the knowledge accumulated during development and qualification, and not on a statistical evaluation. This is the same as in process validation: the number of batches reflects the level of knowledge, not simply a statistical formula.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：驗證維護階段文件
blocks.en: Commentary: Validation Maintenance Stage Documents

blocks.zh: 稽查實務提示
blocks.en: Audit Practice Tip

blocks.zh: 稽查員在驗證維護階段最常要求查看：清潔日誌/批次記錄、趨勢分析報告、變更管控記錄，以及最近一次定期審查報告。這些文件應能快速調閱。
blocks.en: In the validation maintenance stage, auditors most often ask to see: cleaning logs/batch records, trend analysis reports, change control records and the most recent periodic review report. These documents should be quickly retrievable.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：其他文件注意事項
blocks.en: Commentary: Other Documentation Considerations

blocks.zh: 風險評估的溝通義務
blocks.en: The Obligation to Communicate Risk Assessments

blocks.zh: 完成風險評估後，結果必須正式傳達給受影響的部門和職能。這是常被忽視的步驟——風險評估文件不能只存在品保部門的抽屜裡，它的結論必須被相關人員知曉並落實。
blocks.en: After a risk assessment is completed, the results must be formally communicated to the affected departments and functions. This is an often overlooked step: a risk assessment document cannot just sit in a drawer in the QA department; its conclusions must be known to the relevant people and put into practice.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions 練習思考題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 情境一（變更管控）：你的 CIP 機台泵浦原來驗證流量為 60–70 L/min，現在因生產需求想擴展至 70–80 L/min。在進行新流量範圍的清潔驗證前，需要哪些文件與測試？
blocks.en: Scenario 1 (Change Control): The validated flow rate of your CIP skid pump was 60–70 L/min, and production needs now call for extending it to 70–80 L/min. What documents and tests are needed before running cleaning validation at the new flow range?

blocks.zh: Answer Hint 參考提示： Per Section 8.3 — First, a change control record must be initiated. Before cleaning validation can occur at the new range, new validation testing is required to verify that the pump can deliver 70–80 L/min (pump performance qualification). The acceptance criteria for analytical methods should remain unchanged. A test plan justifying reduced sampling may be appropriate if the change only affects flow-related parameters. / 根據 8.3 節：需先啟動變更管控，然後必須先完成泵浦在 70–80 L/min 的性能確效，才能進行清潔驗證。接受標準不應改變，可評估是否縮減取樣點並書面說明理由。
blocks.en: Answer Hint: Per Section 8.3 — First, a change control record must be initiated. Before cleaning validation can occur at the new range, new validation testing is required to verify that the pump can deliver 70–80 L/min (pump performance qualification). The acceptance criteria for analytical methods should remain unchanged. A test plan justifying reduced sampling may be appropriate if the change only affects flow-related parameters.

blocks.zh: 練習二（趨勢分析）：每月趨勢圖顯示最終沖洗 TOC 值在過去 6 個月持續上升，雖仍低於 0.5 ppm 的接受標準，但平均值從 0.08 ppm 升至 0.22 ppm。你應採取什麼行動，為什麼？
blocks.en: Scenario 2 (Trend Analysis): The monthly trend chart shows that the final rinse TOC value has risen steadily over the past 6 months. It is still below the 0.5 ppm acceptance criterion, but the mean has increased from 0.08 ppm to 0.22 ppm. What action should you take, and why?

blocks.zh: Answer Hint 參考提示： Per Section 8.5 — Even though the values are still below the acceptance criterion, an adverse trend should trigger an investigation. Do not wait for a failure. Investigate potential causes: clogged spray device, fouled conductivity/TOC sensor, degraded cleaning agent, or process changes. Document the investigation and corrective actions per your CAPA procedure. / 根據 8.5 節：即使未超標，不良趨勢仍須啟動調查，不能等到失敗才行動。應調查可能原因：噴頭堵塞、感測器污染、清潔劑效力下降或製程變更。調查結果與矯正行動需依 CAPA 程序書面記錄。
blocks.en: Answer Hint: Per Section 8.5 — Even though the values are still below the acceptance criterion, an adverse trend should trigger an investigation. Do not wait for a failure. Investigate potential causes: clogged spray device, fouled conductivity/TOC sensor, degraded cleaning agent, or process changes. Document the investigation and corrective actions per your CAPA procedure.

blocks.zh: 練習三（文件情境）：FDA 查廠員在 PAI 期間要求查看清潔驗證文件。你應備妥哪些文件？你會以什麼順序引導查廠員逐一審閱？
blocks.en: Scenario 3 (Documentation): An FDA investigator asks to see the cleaning validation documents during a PAI. Which documents should you have ready? In what order would you guide the investigator through them?

blocks.zh: Answer Hint 參考提示： Per Sections 9.1–9.4 — Start with the CVMP to show overall strategy; then walk through risk assessments and development reports (9.2); then the validation protocol and final reports (9.3); then evidence of ongoing validation maintenance — monitoring data, trending charts, change control records, training records, and periodic review reports (9.4). CDER expects at least a plan during PAI. / 根據 9.1–9.4 節：從清潔驗證主計畫（CVMP）開始展示整體策略；接著風險評估與開發報告；然後驗證協議書與最終報告；最後是驗證維護記錄——監測數據、趨勢圖、變更管控、訓練記錄與定期審查報告。CDER 在 PAI 時至少期望看到清潔驗證計畫。
blocks.en: Answer Hint: Per Sections 9.1–9.4 — Start with the CVMP to show overall strategy; then walk through risk assessments and development reports (9.2); then the validation protocol and final reports (9.3); then evidence of ongoing validation maintenance — monitoring data, trending charts, change control records, training records, and periodic review reports (9.4). CDER expects at least a plan during PAI.

blocks.zh: Key Terms Glossary 關鍵術語對照表
blocks.en: Key Terms Glossary

blocks.zh: 維持驗證狀態 — 透過變更管控、監測、訓練和定期審查，確保清潔製程持續符合驗證要求的一系列活動。
blocks.en: Maintenance of validated state: the series of activities that, through change control, monitoring, training and periodic review, ensures the cleaning process continues to meet validation requirements.

blocks.zh: 變更管控 — 評估、核准並追蹤所有可能影響驗證狀態的製程變更，包含清潔製程、設備及製造製程的變更。
blocks.en: Change control: evaluating, approving and tracking all process changes that may affect the validated state, including changes to the cleaning process, equipment and manufacturing process.

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數 — 對清潔效果有顯著影響的製程參數，如溫度、壓力、流量、時間、清潔劑濃度（電導度）。
blocks.en: Critical parameters: process parameters that significantly affect cleaning effectiveness, such as temperature, pressure, flow rate, time and cleaning agent concentration (conductivity).

blocks.zh: 定期監測 — 持續性的分析活動，用以確認清潔週期性能符合驗證標準，頻率和方式依風險而定。
blocks.en: Routine monitoring: ongoing analytical activities used to confirm that cleaning cycle performance meets the validation criteria; frequency and approach depend on risk.

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析 — 對監測數據進行統計分析，以識別潛在問題的早期訊號，即使數值尚在接受標準內。
blocks.en: Trend analysis: statistical analysis of monitoring data to identify early signals of potential problems, even when values are still within the acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 累積變更 — 多個單獨通過審查的小變更，其綜合效果可能影響驗證狀態；須定期進行整體評估。
blocks.en: Cumulative changes: multiple small changes, each of which passed review individually, whose combined effect may affect the validated state; an overall evaluation must be performed periodically.

blocks.zh: 文件化 — 清潔驗證知識管理的核心，包含主計畫、開發報告、驗證協議書/最終報告及維護記錄。
blocks.en: Documentation: the core of cleaning validation knowledge management, including the master plan, development reports, validation protocols/final reports and maintenance records.

blocks.zh: 生命週期驗證 — 現代 GMP 觀點，以持續監測取代定期重新驗證，以動態數據管理取代靜態批次通過/失敗。
blocks.en: Lifecycle validation: the modern GMP view, replacing periodic revalidation with continuous monitoring and static batch pass/fail with dynamic data management.
